verdict.rationale: The firm's own offices are all in India (Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi & NCR, Hyderabad, Mumbai), and it describes itself as an independent Indian firm. Its only cross-border reach is membership of the wider CMS organisation, with a global-reach site structure and international CMS legal updates. That network gives a founder an affiliated route abroad, but expansion would still mean engaging a separate CMS member firm rather than this firm's own foreign offices or qualified practices. Missing for 10: own offices or qualified practices outside India, explicit statement of foreign-law qualification, documented details of how cross-border matters run through the CMS network.
